+def _feasible_radii(centers, passes=PROJ_PASS):
+    """Given centers, compute the largest radii that fit the wall and avoid overlap.
+
+    Repeated passes set each radius to the largest allowed by the container wall
+    and by every already-set neighbor; converges to a feasible (often maximal for
+    the given centers) assignment.
+    """
+    n = len(centers)
+    r = [0.0] * n
+    d = [[0.0] * n for _ in range(n)]
+    for i in range(n):
+        xi, yi = centers[i]
+        d[i][i] = 1e9
+        for j in range(i + 1, n):
+            xj, yj = centers[j]
+            d[i][j] = d[j][i] = math.hypot(xi - xj, yi - yj)
+    for _ in range(passes):
+        for i in range(n):
+            xi, yi = centers[i]
+            ri = 1.0 - math.hypot(xi, yi)
+            for j in range(n):
+                if i != j:
+                    v = d[i][j] - r[j]
+                    if v < ri:
+                        ri = v
+            r[i] = ri if ri > 0.0 else 0.0
+    return r
+
+def _score(centers):
+    return sum(_feasible_radii(centers))
